description: We’re a team of motivated students excited to participate in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026! We’re interested in space, technology, AI, and cybersecurity, and we’re eager to learn new skills, share ideas, and create something meaningful together. We’re beginners in hackathons, but we’re creative, willing to learn, and ready to work as a team.
summary:
MISSION: LOST MEMORIES ON MARS is an educational, story-driven adventure game designed for children aged 7–12. Players take the role of an astronaut who crash-lands on Mars and must explore the planet, work with a damaged robotic assistant named NOVA, and uncover the lost memories of a mysterious research mission.

Through five chapters, players investigate their surroundings, repair equipment, solve interactive puzzles, collect clues, and make decisions that affect their resources and the story’s outcome. The game introduces real scientific concepts about Mars, including its atmosphere, moons, dust storms, water history, and NASA’s MOXIE experiment.

Our project addresses the challenge of making space exploration engaging and accessible to younger audiences by turning scientific learning into an interactive adventure. It encourages curiosity, problem-solving, exploration, and decision-making while helping children discover what makes Mars unique and what future human missions might involve.
details:
What It Does:

Bullet Guides players through a 5-part cinematic intro sequence depicting a crash landing on Mars.

Bullet Features 4 interactive chapters with branching decisions that directly impact player survival and memory recovery.

Bullet Includes a living 16-bit environment where greenhouses and spacecraft conditions visually transform when repaired.

Bullet How It Works:

Bullet Tracks global player state variables (Oxygen, Power, Food, Shield, Memory) across scenes.

Bullet Evaluates conditional choices (e.g., unlocking secret greenhouse restoration paths only if players salvaged oxygen reserves in Chapter 1).

Uses NASA scientific data and research to .create realistic Mars exploration challenges

Bullet Tools Used:

Bullet Game Engine & Code: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript,

Bullet Design & Visuals: Canva, 16-bit pixel-art generation tools.

Bullet Deployment: Netlify.
